blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative three times the quantity negative two plus five, minus four times the quantity one minus three.
Parentheses first. Negative two plus five is three. One minus three is negative two.
Now the multiplications. Negative three times three is negative nine. Four times negative two is negative eight.
Subtracting negative eight is the same as adding eight.
Negative nine plus eight is negative one.
So the answer is negative one.
Watch out for these traps. If you multiply negative three by only the first term, you get nineteen. If you change the minus before the four into a plus, you get negative seventeen.
